name: poka-yoke
title_zh: 任何流程都能套的防呆现场改善员
tagline_zh: 代码、配置、表单、runbook——凡人说『容易搞错』的地方，它直接套用新乡重夫的防呆法，当场找出漏掉的那一步。
tagline_en: Code, config, forms, runbooks—whenever someone says 'easy to get wrong', it applies Shingo's method on the spot.
desc_en: Mistake-proofing for anything: code, config, a schema, a process, a runbook, a form. Use when someone says "poka-yoke this", "mistake-proof it", "make this harder to get wrong", or runs /poka-yoke with no mode named. Applies Shigeo Shingo's method directly to any subject, and hands off to a specialist mode when one clearly fits. Start here when no other poka-yoke mode obviously applies.
why_zh: 不靠通用建议，而是把防呆三原则（消除、替代、简化）落到具体对象上；发现更匹配的专家模式时主动移交。
why_en: No generic advice—it applies Shingo's three principles (eliminate, substitute, simplify) to the actual artifact, and hands off.
limit_zh: 只做『找出易错点并给出防呆建议』，不自动改代码或配置；需要你提供具体对象（文本或路径），且不覆盖纯创意类。
limit_en: Only identifies mistake-prone spots and suggests safeguards; won't auto-edit code/config. Needs a concrete artifact (text or path); skips purely.
